description: Scheduled semester fire evacuation drill conducted successfully in Block A. Evacuation time: 4m 12s.
Student slipped on spilled water near wash basin in Canteen. First aid provided, wet floor signage placed.
Short circuit tripped MCB on Block B 2nd floor computer lab. Faulty circuit replaced and load tested.
Student collapsed due to dehydration in quiet study hall. Campus medical team attended and stabilized.
Unauthorized vehicle spotted near perimeter gate 3 after hours. Security verified student identity and escorted.
Substation transformer oil temperature warning alarm triggered in Block C switchyard. Maintenance team on-site investigating.
CCTV camera #4 blind spot reported near emergency stairway. Relocation scheduled.
Code Blue activated in ICU Pod 3. Resuscitation team responded in 90 seconds. Patient stabilized.
Elderly visitor lost balance on entrance ramp in OPD. Wheelchair assistance provided; non-slip tread re-inspected.
Backup UPS phase fluctuation detected in Ward A corridor. Generator auto-transfer switch tested and confirmed normal.
Discrepancy in narcotic storage logbook entry during shift handover. CCTV footage under review by pharmacy head.
Quarterly smoke detector sensitivity test and fire alarm drill conducted in Ward B utility shafts.
High-pressure oxygen manifold line secondary sensor alarm triggered. Switchover to liquid oxygen backup verified.
Ambulance bay blocked by unregistered delivery van. Tow truck summoned and warning issued.
Campus-wide fire warden evacuation drill for floors 1 to 5. 650 employees evacuated in 5m 30s.
Beverage spill in dish collection area. Custodial team cleaned and sanitized floor.
In-row CRAC #2 power supply unit dual-feed transfer glitch. Server room temp rose to 24°C; backup chiller engaged.
Automated license plate reader camera offline at North Gate entrance. Network switch rebooted.
Associate experienced acute vertigo in Tower 2 4th floor workspace. Onsite occupational health nurse responded.
Multiple invalid badge tap attempts at Server Room biometric airlock door #3. Security team reviewing access logs.
